name: @arraypress/bookmark-file
description: Read and write the Netscape bookmark file (NETSCAPE-Bookmark-file-1), the format every browser exports and imports. No DOM: the same reader in a page, a service worker and Node.

scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && node --test tests/*.test.js && npm run duplication
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p . && tsc -p tsconfig.types.json && diff -r -x '*.js' .types src && rm -rf .types

author: David Sherlock
